lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਭੁ ਆਕਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhai vich sabh aakaar hai nirabhau har jeeu soi ||
lines.translation: The entire universe is in fear; only the Dear Lord is fearless.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਿਥੈ ਭਉ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur seviai har man vasai tithai bhau kade na hoi ||
lines.translation: Serving the True Guru, the Lord comes to dwell in the mind, and then, fear cannot stay there.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਸਮਨੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਪੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: dusaman dukh tis no neR na aavai pohi na sakai koi ||
lines.translation: Enemies and pain cannot come close, and no one can touch him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿਆ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh man veechaariaa jo tis bhaavai s hoi ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh reflects upon the Lord in his mind; whatever pleases the Lord - that alone comes to pass.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਪਤਿ ਰਖਸੀ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਵਾਰੇ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak aape hee pat rakhasee kaaraj savaare soi ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, He Himself preserves one's honor; He alone resolves our affairs. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਸਜਣ ਚਲੇ ਇਕਿ ਚਲਿ ਗਏ ਰਹਦੇ ਭੀ ਫੁਨਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik sajan chale ik chal gae rahade bhee phun jaahi ||
lines.translation: Some friends are leaving, some have already left, and those remaining will eventually leave.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਓ ਸੇ ਆਇ ਗਏ ਪਛੁਤਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinee satigur na sevio se aai gae pachhutaahi ||
lines.translation: Those who do not serve the True Guru, come and go regretting.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sach rate se na vichhuRahi satigur sev samaahi ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those who are attuned to Truth are not separated; serving the True Guru, they merge into the Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਜਣੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣਕਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis mileeai satigur sajanai jis a(n)tar har gunakaaree ||
lines.translation: Meet with that True Guru, the True Friend, within whose mind the Lord, the virtuous One, abides.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਹੰਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਮਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis mileeai satigur preetamai jin ha(n)umai vichahu maaree ||
lines.translation: Meet with that Beloved True Guru, who has subdued ego from within himself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਦੇ ਸਭ ਸ੍ਰਿਸ੍ਟਿ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: so satigur pooraa dhan dha(n)n hai jin har upades de sabh srist savaaree ||
lines.translation: Blessed, blessed is the Perfect True Guru, who has given the Lord's Teachings to reform the whole world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਤ ਜਪਿਅਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਭਉਜਲ ਬਿਖੁ ਤਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: nit japiahu sa(n)tahu raam naam bhaujal bikh taaree ||
lines.translation: O Saints, meditate constantly on the Lord's Name, and cross over the terrifying, poisonous world-ocean.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਵਿਟੜਿਅਹੁ ਹੰਉ ਸਦ ਵਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: gur poorai har upadesiaa gur vitaRiahu ha(n)u sad vaaree ||2||
lines.translation: The Perfect Guru has taught me about the Lord; I am forever a sacrifice to the Guru. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਸੁਖੀ ਹੂੰ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur kee sevaa chaakaree sukhee hoo(n) sukh saar ||
lines.translation: Service to, and obedience to the True Guru, is the essence of comfort and peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਐਥੈ ਮਿਲਨਿ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਦਰਗਹ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aithai milan vadiaaeeaa daragah mokh duaar ||
lines.translation: Doing so, one obtains honor here, and the door of salvation in the Court of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਪੈਨਣੁ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachee kaar kamaavanee sach painan sach naam adhaar ||
lines.translation: In this way, perform the tasks of Truth, wear Truth, and take the Support of the True Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachee sa(n)gat sach milai sachai naai piaar ||
lines.translation: Associating with Truth, obtain Truth, and love the True Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਰਖੁ ਸਦਾ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਚਿਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachai sabad harakh sadaa dar sachai sachiaar ||
lines.translation: Through the True Word of the Shabad, be always happy, and you shall be acclaimed as True in the True Court.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੋ ਕਰੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੈ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak satigur kee sevaa so karai jis no nadar karai karataar ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, he alone serves the True Guru, whom the Creator has blessed with His Glance of Grace. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਰ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: hor vidaanee chaakaree dhrig jeevan dhrig vaas ||
lines.translation: Cursed is the life, and cursed is the dwelling, of those who serve another.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਲਗੇ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਟਣਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit chhod bikh lage bikh khatanaa bikh raas ||
lines.translation: Abandoning the Ambrosial Nectar, they turn to poison; they earn poison, and poison is their only wealth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਣਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਪੈਨਣਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਕੇ ਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਰਾਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: bikh khaanaa bikh painanaa bikh ke mukh giraas ||
lines.translation: Poison is their food, and poison is their dress; they fill their mouths with morsels of poison.

lines.gurmukhi: ਐਥੈ ਦੁਖੋ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਮੁਇਆ ਨਰਕਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aithai dukho dukh kamaavanaa muiaa narak nivaas ||
lines.translation: In this world, they earn only pain and suffering, and dying, they go to abide in hell.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੁਹਿ ਮੈਲੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਕਾਮ ਕਰੋਧਿ ਵਿਣਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh muhi mailai sabad na jaananee kaam karodh vinaas ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukhs have filthy faces; they do not know the Word of the Shabad; in sexual desire and anger they waste away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਛੋਡਿਆ ਮਨਹਠਿ ਕੰਮੁ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur kaa bhau chhodiaa manahath ka(n)m na aavai raas ||
lines.translation: They forsake the Fear of the True Guru, and because of their stubborn ego, their efforts do not come to fruition.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਬਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਹਿ ਕੋ ਨ ਸੁਣੇ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jam pur badhe maareeahi ko na sune aradaas ||
lines.translation: In the City of Death, they are bound and beaten, and no one hears their prayers.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak poorab likhiaa kamaavanaa guramukh naam nivaas ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, they act according to their pre-ordained destiny; the Gurmukh abides in the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਹੁ ਸਾਧ ਜਨੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: so satigur sevihu saadh jan jin har har naam driRaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Serve the True Guru, O Holy people; He implants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, in our minds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਜਹੁ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਗੰਨਾਥੁ ਜਗਦੀਸੁ ਜਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: so satigur poojahu dinas raat jin jaga(n)naath jagadees japaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Worship the True Guru day and night; He leads us the meditate on the Lord of the Universe, the Master of the Universe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਨਿਮਖ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਪੰਥੁ ਬਤਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: so satigur dekhahu ik nimakh nimakh jin har kaa har pa(n)th bataaiaa ||
lines.translation: Behold the True Guru, each and every moment; He shows us the Divine Path of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਭ ਪਗੀ ਪਵਹੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਮੋਹ ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis satigur kee sabh pagee pavahu jin moh a(n)dher chukaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Let everyone fall at the feet of the True Guru; He has dispelled the darkness of emotional attachment.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਸਭਿ ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਲਹਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: so satagur kahahu sabh dha(n)n dha(n)n jin har bhagat bha(n)daar lahaaiaa ||3||
lines.translation: Let everyone hail and praise the True Guru, who has led us to find the treasure of the Lord's devotional worship. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਭੁਖ ਗਈ ਭੇਖੀ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur miliai bhukh gaee bhekhee bhukh na jaai ||
lines.translation: Meeting with the True Guru, hunger departs; by wearing the robes of a beggar, hunger does not depart.
